messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable browser game inspired by Brawl Stars with 108 brawlers, selectable maps, and win/loss match outcomes.

## Requirements
- Make it 3D-styled and playable.
- Include all 108 brawlers in the roster.
- Include selectable maps and battle arenas.
- Support winning or losing a match.

## Decisions
- Used a custom canvas/isometric rendering approach rather than WebGL/Three.js.
- Added a polished premium-style game menu and match HUD.
- Assumed a Solo Showdown format with 10 actors.
- Added desktop and mobile controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html` with menu, roster, map selector, HUD, and results screen.
- Created `style.css` with desktop/mobile responsive presentation.
- Created `game.js` with 108 named roster entries, 3 maps, canvas rendering, combat, bots, pickups, controls, and result handling.
- Added `start.sh` for serving on port 3002.

### Active
- The implementation is present but has not been fully browser-verified due to the last code append.
- Syntax validity was previously found to fail with `Unexpected token '}'`; the code was then substantially reconstructed in the latest file state.

### Blocked
- Browser verification and a final syntax/run check are still pending.

## Next Move
1. Run `node --check game.js` and fix any remaining syntax errors.
2. Start the app using `./start.sh`.
3. Open `http://localhost:3002` and verify menu rendering, roster/map selection, match start, movement, combat, and win/loss flow.
4. Capture a latest screenshot and inspect it for blank or broken rendering.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: Main UI structure and screens.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/style.css`: Complete visual styling and responsive layout.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js`: Game logic, roster, maps, canvas scene, combat, bots, and match states.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/start.sh`: Local static server launcher.

## Important Context
- The game is now an original “Star Brawl” themed implementation, not an official asset-backed Brawl Stars game.
- The roster count is represented by 108 entries in `names`.
- A known prior syntax error was `Unexpected token '}'` at `game.js` end, though the file was subsequently rewritten and needs rechecking.
